correctness.rationale: The homogeneous equation has a single infinity point; the affine derivative in v equals one. Irreducibility follows from the primitive p-denominator Newton slope at u=infinity. At the projective point the two lower Newton edges are tame binomial a(b^alpha-ca^beta) and smooth b^alpha(a+b^p); higher monomials have strictly greater weighted values. Therefore exactly one cusp branch of pair (alpha,beta) and one smooth branch, transverse with intersection alpha. Plane-branch delta/conductor identities and adjunction yield the formulas and genus. Two rational branches identified into one yield the exact point correction, combined with the cited normalized maximality. The embedded verifier checks all algebraic support and integer identities on 35 sample parameters, not universality.

value.rationale: The first explicit unbounded maximal automorphism-free curves have a highly singular ordinary plane closure. Its exact two rational branches, cusp value semigroup and conductor multidegrees determine adjunction and a concrete two-point canonical class, useful for compactification and adjoint systems. Rational-point loss and singular-model zeta over every extension are new direct consequences. These are full natural embedded invariants, not arbitrary finite arithmetic examples.
